programs.name: Factorial (6! = 720)
programs.description: Iterative factorial via a software multiply-by-repeated-addition subroutine (JAL/JALR) - base RV32I has no hardware multiply.

programs.name: GCD (48, 18 = 6)
programs.description: Euclid's algorithm, with the modulo step computed by repeated subtraction - base RV32I has no hardware divide/remainder.

programs.name: Bubble sort [5,3,8,1,9,2]
programs.description: Sorts a 6-element in-memory array - loads, stores, and branches over the array bounds.
